english.title: Auctioneer / carrier / warehouseman fail to report forthwith the loss or theft of firearm ammunition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[an auctioneer,]_
(B)_[a carrier,]_
(C)_[a warehouseman,]_

failed to report forthwith to the police the loss or theft of ammunition which, by virtue of section 9(1) of the Firearms Act 1968,

(D)_[you]_
(E)_[a servant of yours, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..),]_

had in

(F)_[your]_
(G)_[his]_
(H)_[her]_

possession without holding a certificate
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(1)(b) and (2) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988.
